item.summary: fix(ui): use session-key equivalence for active-row lookups in model/thinking/fast-mode paths (#124020) Six sites strict-compared row.key === sessionKey while the sibling locked check already used areUiSessionKeysEquivalent (#104045 upgraded only the model path). In alias/transition windows (pre-hello legacy 'main' vs canonical agent:main:main) the optimistic thinking/fast-mode row patch found no row — the click produced no immediate visible change — and the display resolvers missed the active row, falling back to agent defaults. All lookups now go through the equivalence helper the rest of the flow uses.
